description: Pull genotype calls for a germplasm × variant set and pivot them into a matrix. `matrix-json` registers a wide canvas dataframe; `vcf-lite` adds VCF-subset text in `vcf`; `plink` adds .ped/.map text in `ped`/`map`. Text formats pull /variants metadata and convert zero-based BrAPI start to one-based positions; missing/invalid positions use `.`/`0`. Read the dataframe with brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL). `variantColumnLegend` maps SQL-safe columns to original variant IDs.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

format.description: Output format. `matrix-json` registers a wide canvas dataframe only. `vcf-lite` returns VCF-subset text and registers the dataframe. `plink` returns .ped/.map text and registers the dataframe.

germplasmDbIds.description: Restrict to these germplasm. Omit to pull all germplasm in the variant set (use with caution on large sets).

maxCalls.description: Lower the pull cap for this call. Omit to use the deployment ceiling. Cannot raise it: a value above the deployment ceiling is clamped down to it and the effective cap is reported in `warnings`.

maxColumns.description: Lower the distinct-variant column cap for this call. Omit to use the deployment ceiling. Cannot raise it: a value above the deployment ceiling is clamped down to it. When the variant set resolves more distinct variants than the effective cap, the matrix is capped at that many variant columns, `truncated` is set, and the effective cap is reported in `warnings`. Independent of `maxCalls`, which bounds the row (call) pull.

variantSetDbId.description: Variant set to pull calls for. Required. List variant sets with brapi_raw_get({ path: "/variantsets" }) — add params.studyDbId to narrow to one study or genotyping project — and read variantSetDbId from the rows.

name: brapi_export_genotype_matrix

callFormatting.description: Genotype-encoding hints echoed by the server.

columnCount.description: Number of variant columns in the matrix (excluding the germplasm ID column).

dataframe.description: The wide germplasm × variant matrix, staged for every format; brapi_dataframe_export writes it to a file where that tool is listed. vcf, ped, and map serialize the same data.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_not_found`: An uncaught BrAPI data request answered HTTP 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: An uncaught BrAPI data request exhausted retries after HTTP 429. `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `no_filters`: No variantSetDbId was provided. `search_endpoint_disabled`: The active dialect declares POST /search/calls as known-dead on this server. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

format.description: The output format that was produced.

map.description: PLINK .map text — chromosome, variant ID, genetic-distance placeholder 0, and one-based position (BrAPI start + 1). Missing/invalid coordinates use `0`. Present for format="plink".

notice.description: The matrix dataframe and the tools that read it.

ped.description: PLINK .ped text — FID IID PAT MAT SEX PHENO placeholders (all 0) followed by biallelic genotype pairs per variant, one row per sample. Present only when format="plink". Alleles are passed through verbatim; PLINK missing is `0`.

rowCount.description: Number of call-set (germplasm) rows in the matrix.

truncated.description: True when the matrix is not the complete upstream result: the call pull reached the effective maxCalls cap or ran out of time before the last page, or more distinct variants came back than the effective maxColumns cap. `warnings` names which.

variantColumnLegend.description: SQL-safe dataframe column name → original variantDbId.

vcf.description: VCF-lite text — header `#CHROM POS ID REF ALT` plus genotype columns. One-based POS is BrAPI start + 1; missing/invalid coordinates use ".". Present for format="vcf-lite".

title: Brapi Export Genotype Matrix
